sections.text: 長生祿刃，根之重者也；墓庫餘氣，根之輕者也。
sections.usage: Qualitative classes, not numeric weights or a complete strength decision.

sections.text: 得一比肩，不如得支中一墓庫，如甲逢未、丙逢戌之類。乙逢戌、丁逢丑，不作此論，以戌中無藏木、丑中無藏火也。
sections.usage: Register the two positive and two explicitly excluded tomb examples. Excluded-as-tomb is not a whole-chart rootlessness judgment.

sections.text: 得二比肩，不如得一餘氣，如乙逢辰、丁逢未之類。
sections.usage: Register these two residual examples; do not convert the comparison into a 2:1 score.

sections.text: 得三比肩，不如得一長生祿刃，如甲逢亥寅卯之類。陰長生不作此論。
sections.usage: 甲亥/寅/卯 are heavy-class examples. Do not infer a three-point weight or extend the class to yin-stem birth stages.

sections.text: 然乙逢午、丁逢酉之類，亦為有根。
sections.usage: Presence under this author's convention, with no heavy grade assigned. Kept distinct from same-element hidden-stem observations.

sections.text: 如甲與己合，而甲己中間以庚隔之，則甲豈能越尅我之庚而合己。以乙間之，則己豈能越尅我之乙以合甲。此制於勢也，合而不敢合也。
sections.usage: Recognize only 甲己 with intervening 庚 or 乙 as this source's obstruction examples. Other pairs and absence of these examples do not establish a successful transformation.
